newsitem.title: CANADA: Cominco Ltd starting up Trail lead plant.
newsitem.headline: Cominco Ltd starting up Trail lead plant.

text.p: Cominco Ltd said on Wednesday it was starting up its new lead plant at Trail, British Columbia and that it would be several months before the facility was running at full capacity.
Cominco began heating the plant's furnace on March 7, Richard Fish, chief public relations officer at the Trail facility, said in a telephone interview.

"We're still heating the furnace and going through the check-out procedures leading up to putting the first feed on," Fish said. He said it would be few months before the new 120,000 tonne per year lead plant was fully operational.
"We would say it will probably take several months to work it up to full capacity. There is usually an adjustment period with all the new systems," Fish said.
